AT THE
FOOTHILLS
OF THE DRAKENSBERG
Situated in the Witkoppe mountain range in the Eastern Free State, Kloofsig is surrounded by exceptionally beautiful sandstone mountains, adjacent to several deep gorges.
Johannesburg 2.5 hours
Pretoria 3 hours
Midlands 3 hours
Durban 4.5 hours
GOOGLE MAP
THE
ECO LODGE
The lodge is the only accommodation on the farm, so you will have complete privacy and the luxury of having a farm with spectacular views and several gorges to explore, all to yourself.
The renovated farm style house has 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, an open plan living & kitchen area that lives out onto a large deck, with beautiful views of the mountains and a wood fired hot tub to relax in.
Find the balance between comfort and authentic eco living.
If you want to unwind and get away from it all,
you re at the right place.
MORE
REMOTE
OFF-GRID GETAWAY
Kloofsig is off the grid and off the beaten track.
Take a breath and experience life at a slower pace.
Hot water is supplied by a traditional donkey boiler. Our guests love going back to basics of lighting a fire for hot water or to enjoy the wood-fired hot-tub.
A small solar system powers the fridge and lights. The lighting is minimal to keep the balance between comfort and off-grid atmosphere. At Kloofsig there is no shortage of fire places: 2 fire places in the living room, an indoor braai as well as a sandstone boma outside overlooking the mountains.
The lodge is equipped with wifi.
Cellphone reception is limited in the area.

FAQ
What time is check-in & checkout?
We use a self-check-in service. A code to access the keys and all necessary information will be sent prior to arrival.
Check-in: from 3:00 PM
Checkout: 11:00 AM
We are happy to arrange for an earlier check-in or later checkout if possible. Please contact us to arrange.
Do I require a 4x4?
A 4×4 is not required, however a vehicle with high ground clearance is necessary.
Eg. SUV, bakkie, cross-over, etc.
After heavy rains, the roads can get slippery or muddy. When this is the case we’ll be in contact with you to make arrangements.
Are dogs allowed?
Well behaved dogs are welcome at Kloofsig at no extra charge.
Rules:
• no puppies
• no dogs on furniture (incl. beds)
• please ensure that dogs are always attended
• no hunting / chasing wild animals or cattle
• bring along your own dog beds, blankets & dog food
• please pack extra towels for rainy weather
• keep house clean of any mess caused by pets
Note:
Please take responsibility for the safety of your pet.
Kloofsig will not be held responsible for any injury or
loss of a pet.
Is the property fenced for dogs?
The fence around the property & yard is for game, horses and cattle. It is not suitable to keep dogs inside the yard.
We are planning to change this is the future. Please keep a look out on social media for the update.
Is there wifi?
Yes! There’s free wifi at the Eco Lodge.
Is there cellphone reception?
Cellphone reception is limited in the area. The spots with reception will be pointed out.
We do however have free wifi at The Eco Lodge.
Are there shops nearby?
The closest shops are in Memel which is a 30min drive from Kloofsig.
For groceries the basics are available.
Both Butcheries are recommended for braai meat (this is cattle country after all).
In Memel you will find the following:
TeVrede Slaghuis / Butchery
Memel Slaghuis / Butchery
Shoprite
Memel Drankwinkel / Liquir Store
Memel Hotel & Bar
VKB Co-op & Foods
Petrol Station
Pep Clothing
Are there walking/hiking trails?
If you are keen on hiking, mountain biking or trail running there are many cattle paths to follow along and through the gorges. Our routes are not marked, so please take the map along (sent via whatapp & in information book).
There are short walks that you can even do for a coffee over the gorge in the morning or you can venture out for long hikes, exploring and hunting for caves and waterfalls. There are deep gorges that can not be accessed by vehicle, so many undiscovered gems all over the farm.
Keep a look out and see if you can spot zebra, black wildebeest, ostriches, or fallow deer. A special sighting is also the Verreaux’s eagle breeding pair that stays in the mountain and hunt along the gorges.
If it’s windy at the lodge, don’t be deterred from going down into the gorge. Often it is wind-still and a pleasant climate.
Is firewood supplied?
We supply wood for the donkey boiler and hot-tub.
Bags of wood will be available to purchase for the fireplace & braaiing.
Is the water dafe to drink?
The water is safe to drink.
Enjoy the fresh water from 100m underneath the earth.
Is the kitchen well equipped?
The kitchen is well equipped with the necessary utensils, pots, pans, plates, glases etc.
It also includes a plunger, No3 potjie, braai grids and braai tongs.
There is a large fridge/freezer that runs on solar and a large gas oven & stove.
Appliances like microwaves or air-fryer cannot be used on the small solar system.
Are condiments supplied?
The Eco lodge is full self-catering. Please bring along salt, pepper, coffee, tee, sugar, spices etc.
We do supply dishwashing liquid and necessary cleaning products.
Cancellation Policy?
Free cancellation for 48 hours, as long as the guest cancels at least 14 days before check-in. After that, guests can cancel up to 7 days before check-in and get a 50% refund of the nightly rate.
Do you have a 2-sleeper unit?
At this point The Eco Lodge (Sleeps 10) is the only accommodation on the farm.
We are planning smaller cabins in the future….keep an eye on our social media!
What is a donkey boiler?
A donkey boiler heats water using fire rather than electricity. A fire must be made to heat up the water for a hot bath/shower. The water in the boiler remains hot for hours.
TIP:  We recommend starting the fire in the boiler before heading to sundowner rock for sunset. By the time you return you’ll have hot water for the evening.

THE ECO LODGE
The renovated farm style house has 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, an open plan kitchen & living area with 2 fireplaces and indoor braai. The lounge and dining space lives out onto a large deck, with beautiful views of the mountains and a wood fired hot tub to relax in. Also to be enjoyed outside is a sandstone braai area.
The Eco Lodge makes use of a traditional donkey boiler for hot water and a small solar system powers the fridge and lights. The lighting is minimal to keep the balance between comfort and off-grid atmosphere.
Wifi is available at the lodge.
The lodge is the only accommodation on the property, so you will have complete privacy and the luxury of having a farm with spectacular views and several gorges to explore, all to yourself. Kloofsig’s game include zebra, black wildebeest, ostriches, fallow deer and lots of small species to keep a look out for. A special sighting is the Verreaux's eagle breeding pair that stays in the mountain and hunt along the gorges. Kloofsig is also an operational agricultural farm with cattle and horses.
